# Traceability Matrix Template

Maintain this as a controlled record or implement equivalent bidirectional links in an approved requirements-management system.

| Source / user need | Requirement | Risk / control | Design element | Implementation item | Test case | Verification record | Result / anomaly | Release |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `AEX-UN-0001` | `AEX-SYS-0001`, `AEX-SWR-0001` | `AEX-HAZ-0001`, `AEX-RC-0001` | `AEX-DES-0001` | path/symbol/config | `AEX-TC-0001` | `AEX-VER-0001` | Pass or `AEX-ANOM-0001` | version/build |

## Coverage review

- [ ] Every approved requirement has an approved source or rationale.
- [ ] Every requirement is allocated to design and implementation.
- [ ] Every risk control is expressed as a requirement where implemented in software.
- [ ] Every requirement and risk control has passing verification evidence or an approved disposition.
- [ ] Every implementation/configuration change maps back to an authorized change and requirement.
- [ ] Superseded items preserve history and replacement links.
- [ ] Released anomalies and deviations are approved and linked.
- [ ] The matrix identifies the exact baselines and release evaluated.
